# Boulder: a jittered, faceted ball 1 m across, origin at its centre (the game rolls it). Up Z.
new
material new Rock --base-color 0.3373 0.1961 0.1490 --no-slot
material new Vein --base-color 0.6745 0.4196 0.1490 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Boulder --subdivisions 2 --radius 0.5 --location 0 0 0
material assign Rock
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.07 --seed 9
select face where "pos.z > 0.3 && pos.x > 0.05"
material assign Vein
select face where "pos.z < -0.25 && pos.y > 0.1"
material assign Vein
mode object
shade flat
export boulder.glb
